example: What makes you think the plan will work?
exampleZh: 甚麼令你認為這個計劃會成功？

examples.en: What makes you think the plan will work?
examples.zh: 甚麼令你認為這個計劃會成功？
examples.highlight: What makes you think the plan will work?

rules.zh: 在 What makes + 人物 + think...? 中，make 後面要接人物，再直接接動詞原形；不可在動詞前加入 to。
rules.en: make What makes you think the plan will work? What makes you to think the plan will work? make + person + base verb makes you think made him believe could make them change

rules.zh: 目標表達【What】是 makes 的主語因此，直接問句不需要加入 do、does 或 did。本課不教授帶有特殊強調語氣的 What does make...，以免與核心句型混淆。
rules.en: What What makes you think she is ready? What does make you think she is ready? What made you think the shop was closed? What did make you think the shop was closed?

rules.zh: 後面的 clause 使用陳述句語序外層是問句，但 think 後面的內容仍然使用：【subject + verb】
rules.en: think What makes you think the plan will work? What makes you think will the plan work? What makes you think Daniel knows the answer? What makes you think does Daniel know the answer? subject + verb

rules.zh: 目標表達【that】可以省略本練習統一省略 that，使句子更簡潔自然。
rules.en: that Both are correct: What makes you think the plan will work? What makes you think that the plan will work?

rules.zh: 注意 makes、made 和 make 目前甚麼令你認為……？ 當時甚麼令你認為……？ 發生了甚麼，令你現在認為……？ 情態動詞後面使用原形 make，不使用 makes。
rules.en: Present: What makes you think...? Past: What made you think...? Present perfect: What has made you think...? After a modal: What would make you think...? What could make you think...?

rules.zh: 這個問句有時帶有懷疑或挑戰語氣甚麼令你認為自己是對的？ 這句可能表示說話者不完全同意對方。如需要較柔和的語氣，可以使用：【Could you explain what makes you think you are right?】 你可以解釋甚麼令你認為自己是對的嗎？ 我想了解甚麼令你認為自己是對的。
rules.en: What makes you think you are right? Could you explain what makes you think you are right? I would like to understand what makes you think you are right.

benefits.zh: 這個句型不只是詢問對方有甚麼看法，而是進一步詢問哪項事實、跡象或經歷令對方產生該看法。你為甚麼認為這個計劃會成功？ 甚麼令你認為這個計劃會成功？ 第二句更集中詢問支持該想法的根據。
benefits.en: It asks for the evidence behind an opinion This structure does not merely ask what someone thinks. It asks what fact, sign or experience caused that belief. Compare: Why do you think the plan will work? What makes you think the plan will work?

benefits.zh: 人們有時會在未核實資料前作出判斷。這個句型能幫助你詢問對方是如何得出結論的。甚麼令你認為商店已經關門？ 店內的燈已關掉。 這樣便可以找出對方判斷背後的理由。
benefits.en: It helps you examine assumptions People sometimes make a decision before checking whether their information is correct. This structure helps you ask how they reached their conclusion. What makes you think the shop is closed? The lights are off.

benefits.zh: 你不需要只說「我不同意」，而可以請對方解釋其想法的根據，令討論可以繼續下去。甚麼令你認為新規則會引起問題？ 這個問法可以引導對方提供例子、資料或經驗。
benefits.en: It helps continue a discussion Instead of simply saying “I disagree”, you can ask the other person to explain the basis of the idea. What makes you think the new rule will cause problems?

benefits.zh: 當對方提出令人意外的說法，或似乎誤解了某件事時，你可以使用這個句型核實情況。甚麼令你認為會議已被取消？ 訊息只是說會議改到另一個房間舉行。
benefits.en: It is useful for checking claims and misunderstandings You can use the structure when someone makes a surprising claim or appears to have misunderstood something. What makes you think the meeting has been cancelled? The message says it has only been moved to another room.

benefits.zh: 核心句型可以直接放在句首，也可以放在禮貌開場語之後，使語氣較柔和。甚麼令你認為這些數字有錯？ 你可以解釋甚麼令你認為這些數字有錯嗎？
benefits.en: It can be made direct or polite The core structure can be placed at the beginning for a direct question, or after a polite opening for a softer tone. Direct: What makes you think the figures are wrong? Polite: Could you explain what makes you think the figures are wrong?

benefits.zh: 同一個核心句型可以用於直接問句、禮貌問句、陳述句及轉述問句，讓說話和寫作不會只重複同一種句式。
benefits.en: It gives you useful sentence variety You can use the same central structure in direct questions, polite questions, statements and reported speech. What makes you think...? Can you explain what makes you think...? I wonder what makes you think.... She asked what made him think....
